name: arithmetic-vat
objective: Compute the total price for 3 units at EUR 12.50 each, plus 19% VAT on the subtotal.
output_contract: A single EUR amount rounded to 2 decimals, with a one-line calculation.

candidates.A: Subtotal 3 x 12.50 = 37.50 EUR; VAT 19% = 7.125 EUR; total = 44.63 EUR (rounded from 44.625).
candidates.B: Subtotal 3 x 12.50 = 37.50 EUR; adding 19 EUR VAT gives a total of 56.50 EUR.
candidates.C: Subtotal 3 x 12.50 = 37.50 EUR; VAT 19% = 6.55 EUR; total = 44.05 EUR.
